name: Cúpla
description: The bilingual café whose name is the Irish for twins — given an identity built on the pair, with every label twinned in Irish and English.

name: Scopers
description: Northern Ireland's first zero-waste hot food bar, currently behind a Facebook login — given a first page that leads with the chef and a standing supper-club invitation.

name: The Bucks Head
description: The village pub under chef Alex Greene, given a first screen that books tables — date, party and area passing straight into the ResDiary engine it already runs.

name: Donard Veterinary Clinic
description: The practice's own badge — Mourne silhouette, plum and teal — sets the whole screen, with an appointment-request card up front and the emergency call one tap away.

name: Mourne Cycles
description: The area's Trek dealer given back its own name — a storefront opening screen with the range, a bookable workshop and the Cycle to Work saving up front.

name: Enniskeen Country House Hotel
description: A loved, family-run country house reframed around its valley view — with a direct availability path into the hotel's existing booking engine.

name: Castle Farm Fresh Produce
description: A calmer arrival, a clear shop action and a stronger explanation of the local product — presented as a direct before-and-after.
